course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: The reply arrived later: which intention does it confirm?
goal: Accept current intent, cancel No and reject stale answers without persisting a document.

prerequisites.text: onec.p7; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: A question before observation
paragraphs: While a Yes/No question is open, the user can change minutes or start another request. A Yes alone is insufficient: it must match the current version and the same data snapshot.

sections.title: Continuations run later
paragraphs: An asynchronous dialog returns control before the user answers. Decision-dependent logic belongs in its continuation rather than the next line as if synchronous. Meanwhile, the form may close, data may change or another request may start. Include those states in the operation contract.

УчебноеПодтверждение increments ВерсияЗапроса and captures minutes. ПоказатьВопрос yields to the UI; ОписаниеОповещения calls ПослеПодтверждения later. Reaching the line after opening a dialog does not mean an answer exists.

sections.title: Continue your own form
paragraphs: Continue your own separate copy with Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги. The code belongs in the managed УчебнаяФормаЗаявки module, not a common module or startup handler. The form already contains Объект. Append only missing methods; do not duplicate existing definitions or load a full CF over your work.

In the form attributes add ИтогОпыта: String(120) and ВерсияЗапроса: Number(10,0). These belong to the form, not the document. The duplicate-reply task additionally needs ОбработаннаяВерсия and РасчетовОпыта: Number(10,0), initially 0.

In the form editor create the command ПоказатьПродолжение, select its existing procedure as the action, and place it on the command bar. Append Команда.bsl to the same form module; do not generate a duplicate empty procedure. Link ПроверитьПовтор similarly for the independent task.

Worked setup: open your own saved 30-minute request. For buffer/directive observations set 77 without saving; the callback command sets 90 and version 2 itself. The server experiment explicitly supplies 90, 1441, and the string “90”.

sections.title: Methods for the worked experiment
paragraphs: Only methods needed for this experiment are shown. If a previous topic already added a method, retain its single definition. The course retains the original complete module.

sections.title: The client command and its actual output
paragraphs: ПоказатьПродолжение calls the real callback directly for No, stale Yes, and current Yes. Results are cancellation, stale intention, and 1.5. The callback also prints 1.5 itself; that extra message is not another calculation. The database remains 30. Direct calls check BSL branches; use УчебноеПодтверждение separately to interact with the actual dialog.

sections.title: Bind confirmation to intent
paragraphs: Preserve request identity and the confirmed snapshot. Before acting, check form and intent validity. An old Yes must not authorize a new request; double-clicking must not create a duplicate. Use explicit pending, accepted, or cancelled state instead of one flag that conflates attempts.

No sets Cancelled immediately. Yes permits calculation only when request generation and current minutes match the snapshot. An old confirmation for 77 must not act after editing 90 or starting another request. The snapshot contains intent data, never credentials.

sections.title: Predict before running
paragraphs: Should a stale Yes execute the new version’s action?
sections.reveal: No. Confirmation belongs to a specific intention. A Yes does not establish that its version or minutes are still current. This experiment never saves a document and makes no claim about cancelling an already accepted remote action.

sections.title: Cancellation has observable effects
paragraphs: No, dialog close and form cancellation must not initiate a write. Once a server operation has committed, local UI cancel need not reverse it: show actual state and a verification route. A closed window does not prove server-effect cancellation. Distinguish timeout and environment unavailability.

Even acceptance only computes hours; no document write occurs. Check cancellation using the result and persisted 30. In a real remote operation closing a dialog does not revoke an already accepted server effect: use an operation ID and reconcile outcome.

sections.title: The mistake this experiment distinguishes
paragraphs: Removing the version check lets an old reply authorise new state. Without duplicate protection, the same current callback can also repeat a calculation. The independent task checks both boundaries explicitly.

sections.title: Tests control event ordering
paragraphs: TestYes, No, double-click, response after close and two replies arriving in reverse order. Tie each to its ownIDand state. One fast success does not test asynchrony: use a controlled delay in a safe stand and verify no late write. An explanatory event diagram is not BSL execution.

Manually test Yes/No through the actual dialog. Separately invoke the exported continuation with current/stale versions and changed minutes to reproduce event ordering. That executes real BSL branches but does not prove a physical dialog click. Report these evidence types separately.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Preserve the old callback and add ПослеНовогоПодтверждения. With version 9 and 150 minutes, reject version 8; the first current Yes calculates 2.5 once; its duplicate returns “Уже обработано” without recalculation. Add numeric form attributes ОбработаннаяВерсия and РасчетовОпыта. A current No cancels without calculating; a stale No must not cancel the new intention. No document is saved.
Preserve your prediction and code before viewing the reference. The worked example does not solve this new task. Viewing its files does not replace your work.

sections.title: What was established and what you explain
paragraphs: A local file infobase establishes the chosen branches and contexts, not network latency, clustering, all permissions, or learner understanding. Record direct callbacks and physical dialog interaction separately.
Distinguish a direct callback invocation, dialog interaction, and a remote operation’s result; do not substitute one for another.
